comments.text: All children closed: Cyclotron, Tactus and Chattic marketing sites migrated and live; page blocks, islands, family footer, clean URLs in core; follow-ups 7954f8, 9cd419, 2c3c69, c385b2, 715a85, 5e3d24, 13369f done with evidence on each; the three sites run Papyrus 5.12.0+ and deploy from their pipelines (Amplify for Tactus, CodePipeline for Chattic and Cyclotron).
